scope: Acceptance contract for the first multimodal release; targets are not measurements or shipped features.

baseline.other_native_measurements: unmeasured; cross-compilation and archive size do not establish native performance

tasks.exact_designation: Find a named entity or reviewed alias, including punctuation and spelling variants.
tasks.descriptive: Find an entity from its role or visible characteristics without its designation.
tasks.specification: Find an entity using documented capabilities, quantities, and units.
tasks.photograph: Find the pictured entity from a photograph absent from the gallery.
tasks.image_text: Find the pictured entity with a short textual constraint.
tasks.unseen_view: Recognize an indexed entity in an independently captured view.
tasks.crop: Recognize a partial view without treating a cropped gallery photograph as unseen.
tasks.diagram: Retrieve source-backed entities from annotated drawings or diagrams.
tasks.confusable_variant: Distinguish close variants only when the query supplies distinguishing evidence.
tasks.no_match: Abstain for an absent entity, including plausible in-domain equipment and unrelated images.

evaluation.split_unit: underlying photograph; resized, recompressed, mirrored, and cropped derivatives share one photo_group and split
evaluation.gallery_rule: No evaluation or development query photo_group, or its derivatives, may enter the benchmark gallery/index. Enforce this exclusion after full source capture, not just in fixture labels. Independently photographed gallery views of the same entity may enter.
evaluation.labels: Use source-backed IDs and reviewed evidence; ambiguous images allow multiple justified IDs or abstention, never an invented exact variant.
evaluation.thresholds: Fit abstention and fusion parameters on development cases only; freeze before evaluation.
evaluation.pilot: Report counts and observed metrics only. The small M1 fixture is a review seed, not evidence that release quality gates pass.
evaluation.report_requirements: Show numerator, denominator, excluded/pending cases, and 95% Wilson intervals. Do not count unreviewed or missing images as passing. Report unfiltered global search separately; source filters must not hide distractors.

metrics.top1: Fraction of positive queries marked candidates whose first result belongs to expected_ids; divide by all positive queries, so abstentions count as misses.
metrics.recall_at_5: Fraction of positive queries marked candidates with any expected_id in the first five distinct entities; divide by all positive queries, so abstentions count as misses.
metrics.wrong_variant_top1: Fraction of confusable queries whose first accepted result is in confusable_ids.
metrics.false_acceptance: Fraction of negative queries marked candidates instead of no_supported_match; ranked suggestions under no_supported_match are not accepted matches.

quality_targets.status: frozen M1 targets; evaluate at release sample sizes, not the small pilot
quality_targets.text_regression: All 73 existing required cases retain their expected rank bound. On all 116 frozen cases, recall@5 and mean reciprocal rank must not fall below M1; missing baseline sources are failures, not skips.
quality_targets.combined_regression: On the same evaluation photographs, image-plus-text recall@5 must be at least image-only recall@5.

resource_targets.status: frozen M1 budgets; no image or combined performance measurements exist in M1
resource_targets.comparison_scope: Frozen 4337-entity text corpus plus at most 10000 indexed image views; same hardware, text dataset, query set, runtime settings, and background load for regression comparisons. Record both executable hashes and each media-gallery hash.
resource_targets.latency_definition: Wall time from process launch through complete output, including model loading, image decoding, and search. First observed launch is not OS-cache-cleared cold start; repeated launches are not an in-process warm service.
resource_targets.memory_definition: Per-process OS peak resident working set; do not substitute Python wrapper memory or private virtual bytes.
resource_targets.size_definition: MiB = 1048576 bytes; each supported platform must pass. Original media remains outside the executable.
resource_targets.release_validation: Measure native latency and memory on all five targets before release; select and record each target's hardware before model comparison. Until then only Windows reference results are established.

first_release_contract.image_input: One local JPEG or PNG; reject unreadable, corrupt, or unsupported input with a JSON error on stderr and nonzero exit. No URL fetching during search.
first_release_contract.flags: Flags precede the positional text. Keep --source, --kind, --category and --limit 1..100 (default 10); --mode applies to text-only search, and an explicit --mode with --image is rejected.

envelope_additions.query_image_sha256: Present for image inputs; never embed the user's query image or local path.

result_additions.matches: Evidence contributions with channel, score, evidence_id, canonical source URL, and media_id for visual evidence; include model/recipe identity for generated observations.
result_additions.score: Preserve score=cosine for text-only --mode vector. Hybrid and image modes use an entity ranking score; scores are ranking signals, not probabilities of identity.
result_additions.cosine: Keep the existing text cosine meaning; use null for image-only results. Image cosine belongs to the image contribution.
result_additions.name_match: False when there is no text query.

first_release_contract.ranking: One result per source-qualified entity. Keep model spaces separate and fuse rankings, never unrelated vectors. Aggregate diverse views without rewarding duplicate counts.
first_release_contract.no_match: Always return match_status. no_supported_match may retain ranked suggestions for inspection and text compatibility; these are explicitly not accepted identifications. Calibrate each modality on development positives and negatives.
first_release_contract.offline: Embed required query models and vectors. Search, get, similar, info, and verify make no network requests; heavy OCR and description models run only during construction.
deferred: Direct text-to-image retrieval using a paired visual text encoder

media_and_compatibility.discovery: Adapters describe candidates through one shared media interface. Site-specific discovery and supporting files stay in that source's package.
media_and_compatibility.storage: Shared resumable downloader retains verified originals by content hash in the durable local archive. Atomic partial downloads and decode/resize intermediates use temporary storage.
media_and_compatibility.provenance: Preserve original URLs, captions, source responses, capture times, entity/evidence associations, and processing/model revisions. Generated observations remain distinct from source statements.
media_and_compatibility.distribution: Embed selected compact previews within the size budget and expose whether a matching preview is present; original bytes stay in the local archive for reprocessing and inspection.
media_and_compatibility.stable_ids: Preserve every existing SOURCE:ID and evidence ID. Deduplicating image bytes never merges entity identities.
media_and_compatibility.commands: Existing text search, similar, get formats json/markdown/html/source, info, version, and verify continue to work. Original source exports remain byte-identical.
media_and_compatibility.bundles: New code can read existing format-2 text bundles and snapshots; absent media is valid. Unsupported newer formats fail clearly. Old binaries are not expected to read new bundle formats.
media_and_compatibility.verification_gate: M1 verified by the user. Advance one milestone at a time, requiring user verification before starting the next.
